title: Decision Table: Seasoning Supplement on Year-End Security Deposits Interest
content:
A cash Security Deposits deposit that has been held for some time earns a seasoning supplement on the rate of its December 31 accrual. The supplement comes from the whole months from the deposit's paid-in-full date to the last day of the year before the accrued year.

## Rule

At least the long seasoning months of **24** earn the long seasoning supplement of **0.25** percentage points; at least the short seasoning months of **12** but fewer than 24 earn the short seasoning supplement of **0.10** percentage points; fewer than 12 earn none. The supplement is added to the commission rate of the December 31 accrual, in percentage points.

## Decision table

| Whole months from the paid-in-full date to December 31 of the year before the accrued year | Seasoning supplement |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0.25 |
| 12 to 23 | 0.10 |
| 0 to 11 | none |

## Hypothetical illustrations (accrued year 2025, months counted to December 31, 2024)

| Paid-in-full date | Whole months to December 31, 2024 | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| December 31, 2022 | 24 | 0.25 |
| January 15, 2023 | 23 | 0.10 |
| December 31, 2023 | 12 | 0.10 |
| February 10, 2024 | 10 | none |

The paid-in-full date is the one shown on the deposit record.
